answer_1.quote: We evaluated MARS and compared it with several popular NLG metrics on the following three tasks: Story Generation. We use the ROC stories dataset for story generation... News Summarization. For the news summarization task, we use the Newsroom summary dataset... Question Answering. For question answering, we use the MOCHA dataset...
answer_1.outputs: generated story endings, news summaries, and answers to questions

answer_2.quote: We apply MARS to three diverse NLG tasks, and demonstrate that, compared with seven popular NLG metrics, MARS better correlates with human judgements...

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to further study the quality of MARS augmentation.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to evaluate the relevance to context, readability, and overall quality of the generated text on a scale from 1-7.
